facts.text: India's installed solar capacity grew from **2.8 GW (2014) to 171 GW**, with solar tariffs falling from about ₹8/unit to as low as ₹2.15/unit; under PM Surya Ghar, 21+ lakh of a 65-lakh-home target now have zero electricity bills; the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit (Bharat Mandapam, 2-5 Nov) hosts the 9th ISA Assembly and the 4th International Conference on Green Hydrogen, with India targeting $220 billion in investment for 500 GW of non-fossil capacity by 2030.

facts.text: PLFS data show India's unemployment rate fell from **6.1% (2017-18) to 3.2% (2023-24)**, but a Decent Work Index (DWI) rose only from 0.247 to 0.302 over the same period; nearly 90% of the workforce remains informally employed (India Employment Report 2024, ILO-IHD), and agriculture's DWI (0.211→0.267) stayed the lowest despite four Labour Codes notified in 2025.
facts.plain: PLFS data show India's unemployment rate fell from 6.1% (2017-18) to 3.2% (2023-24), but a Decent Work Index (DWI) rose only from 0.247 to 0.302 over the same period; nearly 90% of the workforce remains informally employed (India Employment Report 2024, ILO-IHD), and agriculture's DWI (0.211→0.267) stayed the lowest despite four Labour Codes notified in 2025.

facts.text: GST collections rose **23% y-o-y in October to ₹2.31 lakh crore** — the second-highest monthly figure ever and the fastest growth this fiscal year; October was the second straight month gross GST crossed ₹2 lakh crore, and April-October gross GST collection grew 13.2% to over ₹14.77 lakh crore.
facts.plain: GST collections rose 23% y-o-y in October to ₹2.31 lakh crore — the second-highest monthly figure ever and the fastest growth this fiscal year; October was the second straight month gross GST crossed ₹2 lakh crore, and April-October gross GST collection grew 13.2% to over ₹14.77 lakh crore.
keys: 23% y-o-y in October to ₹2.31 lakh crore

facts.plain: Commercial LPG prices rose for a third straight time (Delhi 19-kg cylinder up ₹10 to ₹2,820; Kolkata saw the steepest hike of ₹17 to ₹2,971) and ATF (jet fuel) rose ₹1.37/litre to ₹138.5 — the fourth hike since July — while domestic LPG prices were left unchanged.

facts.text: India hit **E20** (20% ethanol blending) in **2025**, five years ahead of the 2030 target of the **National Policy on Biofuels, 2018**; from **April 2026** all petrol sold must be E20. Concerns: about **5%** mileage loss (govt estimate), water contamination, land and water for feedstock (sugarcane, maize, broken rice), food vs fuel.

facts.text: **MoRTH** amended the **Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989** (Rule 115) to allow **E100** (pure ethanol) and **E85**, only in **flex-fuel vehicles** made by manufacturers; this eases **homologation** (type approval by agencies like **ARAI**). Existing vehicles need not switch.
facts.plain: MoRTH amended the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 (Rule 115) to allow E100 (pure ethanol) and E85, only in flex-fuel vehicles made by manufacturers; this eases homologation (type approval by agencies like ARAI). Existing vehicles need not switch.

facts.text: Fortnightly windfall review: export duty on **petrol cut to nil**; diesel export levy raised by ₹3 to **₹11.5/litre**, **ATF** to **₹11/litre**. The import duty exemption on **cotton** was extended to **31 Dec** (poor monsoon hit the crop).

facts.text: A **tokamak** uses magnets to hold plasma at about **100 million °C** to fuse **deuterium and tritium** into helium. India is a member of **ITER** (France); its own tokamaks are **Aditya** and **SST-1** at the **Institute for Plasma Research**, Gandhinagar.
facts.plain: A tokamak uses magnets to hold plasma at about 100 million °C to fuse deuterium and tritium into helium. India is a member of ITER (France); its own tokamaks are Aditya and SST-1 at the Institute for Plasma Research, Gandhinagar.

facts.text: Bengaluru start-up **Pranos Fusion**, India's first fusion power company, built **PRAGYA**, a small **tokamak** testing plasma control and HTS magnets; it plans the blueprint of a larger tokamak, **PRANIK**, by **2027**. It has raised **$7.2 million**.
facts.plain: Bengaluru start-up Pranos Fusion, India's first fusion power company, built PRAGYA, a small tokamak testing plasma control and HTS magnets; it plans the blueprint of a larger tokamak, PRANIK, by 2027. It has raised $7.2 million.

facts.text: The **Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority (UCADA)** made a **co-pilot** mandatory for helicopters on pilgrimage routes ('two-pilot crew' for all Char Dham charters) and a report after every flight. UCADA CEO: **Prateek Jain**.

facts.text: India imported **209.4 lakh tonnes** of crude in Sept 2026; the import bill of **$14.3 billion** was 33% higher than a year earlier. Russia and the UAE together supply **60%** of India's oil.

facts.text: After the US **'Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026'** (signed **18 Sept**; allows tariffs of up to **100%** on buyers of Russian oil, waived by Trump on 16 Oct), India cut **US oil imports to zero** in September and Russia's share fell from a record **51% (July)** to **33%**; the **UAE** now supplies over a quarter.
facts.plain: After the US 'Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026' (signed 18 Sept; allows tariffs of up to 100% on buyers of Russian oil, waived by Trump on 16 Oct), India cut US oil imports to zero in September and Russia's share fell from a record 51% (July) to 33%; the UAE now supplies over a quarter.

facts.text: NITI Aayog's national MPI paper (Jan 2024) said about **24.82 crore** people escaped multidimensional poverty between 2013-14 and 2022-23. The World Bank's extreme poverty line was revised to **$3.00/day** (2021 PPP) in 2025.
facts.plain: NITI Aayog's national MPI paper (Jan 2024) said about 24.82 crore people escaped multidimensional poverty between 2013-14 and 2022-23. The World Bank's extreme poverty line was revised to $3.00/day (2021 PPP) in 2025.

facts.text: World Bank: multidimensional poverty (OPHI MPI) fell from **53.8% (2005-06) to 16.4% (2019-21)**; the top 10% earn about **13 times** the bottom 10%; a belt from **U.P. to West Bengal** holds **57%** of India's poor; employment rose by about **134 million** in 2017-23, but youth unemployment rose from 14.6% to 15.9%.
facts.plain: World Bank: multidimensional poverty (OPHI MPI) fell from 53.8% (2005-06) to 16.4% (2019-21); the top 10% earn about 13 times the bottom 10%; a belt from U.P. to West Bengal holds 57% of India's poor; employment rose by about 134 million in 2017-23, but youth unemployment rose from 14.6% to 15.9%.

facts.text: **World Bank** Poverty and Equity Brief (Oct 2026): between 2011 and 2023 the share below the lower-middle-income line (**$4.20/day**) fell from **57.7% to 16.1%**, lifting **496 million** people; extreme poverty (**$3.00/day**) fell from **27.1% to 2.6%**.
facts.plain: World Bank Poverty and Equity Brief (Oct 2026): between 2011 and 2023 the share below the lower-middle-income line ($4.20/day) fell from 57.7% to 16.1%, lifting 496 million people; extreme poverty ($3.00/day) fell from 27.1% to 2.6%.

facts.text: **Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI)** is in **Shimla**; its other coloured varieties are **Kufri Neelkanth** and **Kufri Manik**.
facts.plain: Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI) is in Shimla; its other coloured varieties are Kufri Neelkanth and Kufri Manik.

facts.text: **ICAR-CPRI** developed **Kufri Jamunia**, a purple potato rich in **anthocyanins**: per 100 g, vitamin C 42.75 mg (vs 23.15), zinc 2.28 mg (vs 0.28), iron 3.22 mg (vs 0.57). Notified in Nov 2024; matures in about **90 days**; susceptible to **late blight** (*Phytophthora infestans*).
